big_pour.headline: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for automated purchasing agents
big_pour.teaser: ChatGPT Wallet launches for AI agents
big_pour.summary: OpenAI is launching ChatGPT Wallet to allow its Dots AI agents to make purchases for eligible US ChatGPT Pro subscribers. The feature works with select US-issued credit cards.
big_pour.why: US Pro subscribers can now let AI agents buy things automatically using supported credit cards.

explain.kid: OpenAI built a digital wallet so smart computer helpers called Dots agents can buy things for grown-ups in the US who use ChatGPT Pro.
explain.pm: ChatGPT Wallet lets Dots AI agents make purchases for US ChatGPT Pro subscribers aged 18 and older who hold eligible US-issued credit cards.
explain.engineer: OpenAI integrated ChatGPT Wallet into its Dots agents platform, enabling automated transactions for US ChatGPT Pro users with eligible credit cards.

big_pour.headline: Amazon plans global index of internet product data
big_pour.summary: Amazon plans to build the World Product Graph, a vault storing data on every product sold on the internet. The project aims to prevent shoppers from leaving Amazon to research products.

word.definition: An attack where text the model reads (an email, web page, or document) contains instructions that try to override what the app told the model to do.
word.heard: "The summariser followed instructions hidden in the email. Classic prompt injection."
word.analogy: Like a note slipped into an order that says 'make every drink free'.
